Herald Server v0.10.2 Community (Release)
Standalone API server for the Herald logging framework.

Usage:
  dotnet run -c Debug [-- options]       Run in Debug mode
  dotnet run -c Release [-- options]     Run in Release mode
  Herald.Server.exe [options]

Options:
  --port <number>       HTTP port to listen on (default: 5100)
  --log-dir <path>      Directory for log files and sample data (default: logs)
  --verbose, -v         Enable console log output
  --silent              Suppress startup banner
  --api-key <key>       Enable API key auth on /api/* endpoints (off by default)
  --cors-origins <list> Comma-separated CORS origin allowlist
                        (default: localhost-only dev origins)
  --cors-allow-any      Permissive CORS (AllowAnyOrigin). Unsafe if
                        you ever add AllowCredentials; avoid in prod.
  --tenant <id>         Boot-time tenant id for operator pipelines.
                        Defaults to 'default'. Non-default values
                        require the Enterprise edition. Also reads
                        HERALD_TENANT env var.
  --node-id <id>        Stable node id for multi-replica deployments.
                        Also reads HERALD_NODE_ID env var.
  --tls-cert <path>     PEM cert for direct HTTPS (Pro edition).
  --tls-key  <path>     PEM key for direct HTTPS (Pro edition).
  --help, -h            Show this help message

Authentication:
  Off by default. Solo devs and local setups don't need it.
  Enable with --api-key when the server is shared or exposed.
  Clients send the key as:
    Authorization: Bearer <key>
    X-Api-Key: <key>
  /health is always open (no auth required).

Note: Debug vs Release is determined at build time, not by a runtime flag.
Use 'dotnet run -c Debug' to build and run in Debug mode.
Simulation is controlled from the Herald Dashboard UI.

API Endpoints (mapped by SDK/HeraldEndpointMapper):
  GET  /health                    Health check (version, build, uptime)
  GET  /api/config       
[truncated]
